sealing_commit: Resolve with git log -1 --format=%H -- <this manifest>; a commit cannot embed its own SHA
source_hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; runtime batch manifests additionally record exact disk byte hashes

format_contract.duplicates: reject casefold and whitespace-normalized duplicates within each field

generation.temperature: unset, not used by greedy decoding
generation.token_limit: generated_tokens >= 384 is failure in both branches

retrieval.tokenizer: ASCII letters/digits, lowercase; exact implementation frozen by source hash

dataset.split_provenance_limit: mirror original split fields; original author lists not independently reacquired
dataset.qrels: five original same-image captions positive; all other-image captions assumed negative; kind=caption_pair_proxy
dataset.image_sha256: record in append-only download receipts; verify inventory before every run; never select by pixels, captions or results

failure_policy: all 100 selected images in denominator, every failed/interrupted/pending query scores zero; no repair, fallback, deletion, sample substitution or increased attempts

budget.cost: actual billed hours times user-confirmed hourly price; no GPU spending authorized by this manifest
budget.stop: OOM, source/model/hash/environment mismatch or timeout: preserve records, no policy changes or extra attempts

backup: after process stops, archive entire run including both SQLite DBs, manifests, all numbered snapshots, failures, raw outputs and logs; SHA256 archive; copy to Windows and verify before user stops instance
